Time spent in dark chamber:
```{r}
#light preference
df<-  df %>% mutate(time_light=df$`In zone light cumulative s`)
df<-  df %>% mutate(time_dark=600-df$`In zone light cumulative s`)

#relative time spent in dark over light
df<-  df %>% mutate(light_preference=(time_light/(time_light+time_dark))*100)
df<-  df %>% mutate(dark_preference=(time_dark/(time_light+time_dark))*100)
```



LMM



#dark preference
```{r}
#Loading packages for linear mixed effects modelling
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)

#df$Week <- factor(df$Week, levels = c("Preinduction","1st week post induction","2nd week post induction"))

df$Week <- factor(df$Week, levels = c("Preinduction","1st week post induction","2nd week post induction", "3rd week post induction"))

df$genotype <- factor(df$genotype, levels = c("WT","TDP-43"))


#creating a linear model of the same variables as included in the anova
m_anova <-lmer(dark_preference ~  Week*genotype + (1|ID), data=df)
summary(m_anova)

# Obtain estimated marginal means
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ Week*genotype)

# Perform pairwise comparisons
pairwise_results <- contrast(emmeans_results, method = "pairwise")

# Display the results
summary(pairwise_results)

#bonferroni
pwc <- pairs(emmeans_results, adjust = "bon")
pwc

# PLANNED COMPARISONS

emm <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ Week * genotype)
# Weeks compared within each genotype
within_genotype <- pairs(emm, by = "genotype", adjust = "bon")

summary(within_genotype)

# Genotypes compared within each week
between_genotype <- pairs(emm, by = "Week", adjust = "bon")

summary(between_genotype)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(ggsignif)
library(dplyr)

# ----------------------------
# Fix Week labels
# ----------------------------
levels(df$Week)[levels(df$Week) == "1st week post induction"] <- "1st week"

# ----------------------------
# 1️⃣ Combined x-axis variable
# ----------------------------
df$Week_genotype <- interaction(df$genotype, df$Week, sep = "_", lex.order = TRUE)

# X-axis labels (weeks only)
week_labels <- c("Preinduction", "1st week")
x_labels <- rep(week_labels, times = length(levels(df$genotype)))

# ----------------------------
# 2️⃣ Define comparisons
# ----------------------------

# Within-genotype (Pre vs W1)
comparisons_within <- list(
  c("WT_Preinduction", "WT_1st week"),
  c("TDP-43_Preinduction", "TDP-43_1st week")
)

# Between-genotype (WT vs TDP at each timepoint)
comparisons_between <- list(
  c("WT_Preinduction", "TDP-43_Preinduction"),
  c("WT_1st week", "TDP-43_1st week")
)

# ----------------------------
# 3️⃣ Compute staggered y positions
# ----------------------------

y_max_WT  <- max(df$dark_preference[df$genotype == "WT"], na.rm = TRUE)
y_max_TDP <- max(df$dark_preference[df$genotype == "TDP-43"], na.rm = TRUE)
y_max_all <- max(df$dark_preference, na.rm = TRUE)

# small offset for within-genotype
y_positions_within <- c(
  y_max_WT  * 1.05,
  y_max_TDP * 1.05
)

# higher offset for between-genotype
y_positions_between <- c(
  y_max_all * 1.15,
  y_max_all * 1.25
)

# ----------------------------
# 4️⃣ Significance table
# ----------------------------

sig_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(
    sapply(comparisons_within, `[`, 1),
    sapply(comparisons_between, `[`, 1)
  ),
  xmax = c(
    sapply(comparisons_within, `[`, 2),
    sapply(comparisons_between, `[`, 2)
  ),
  y_position = c(
    y_positions_within,
    y_positions_between
  ),
  annotations = c(
    paste0("P = ", formatC(c(WT_pre_1, TDP_pre_1), format = "f", digits = 4)),
    paste0("P = ", formatC(c(Pre_vs_TDP_pre, Pre_vs_TDP_w1), format = "f", digits = 4))
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# 5️⃣ Raincloud plot
# ----------------------------

ggplot(df, aes(x = Week_genotype, y = dark_preference,
               color = genotype, fill = genotype)) +

  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    side = "left",
    adjust = 0.5,
    justification = 1.1,
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.6,
    scale = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_line(aes(group = ID),
            color = "gray50",
            linewidth = 0.5,
            alpha = 0.4) +

  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_crossbar(stat = "summary",
                fun = mean,
                width = 0.2,
                fatten = 1.5,
                color = "black",
                fill = "black") +

  geom_errorbar(stat = "summary",
                fun.data = mean_se,
                width = 0.1,
                color = "black",
                fill = "black") +

  geom_signif(
    data = sig_df,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
        annotations = annotations,
        y_position = y_position),
    manual = TRUE,
    tip_length = 0.02,
    textsize = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +

  ylab("Dark preference (%)") +
  xlab("Timepoint") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))

# ----------------------------
# 6️⃣ Save vector output
# ----------------------------

ggsave("raincloud_plot_LDCT.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave("raincloud_plot_LDCT.svg", width = 10, height = 6)

```

# assumption checks
```{r}
p_load(performance)

check_model(m_anova)

hist(df$dark_preference, breaks = 10)
by(df$dark_preference, list(df$Week, df$genotype), summary)


#3. Random effects structure
#Assumption:
#Mice differ in their baseline level of dark_preference.
#These random intercepts are approximately normally distributed.
ranef_ID <- ranef(m_anova)$ID[,1]
hist(ranef_ID)
qqnorm(ranef_ID); qqline(ranef_ID)


# 4. Residual normality
# Assumption:
# The residuals (observed minus fitted) are approximately Gaussian.
res <- resid(m_anova)

hist(res, breaks = 10)
qqnorm(res); qqline(res)



```

```{r}
res <- resid(m_anova)
fit <- fitted(m_anova)

plot(fit, res,
     xlab = "Fitted values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted (Global)")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")


# Residuals vs Week
plot(df$Week, resid(m_anova),
     xlab = "Week",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Week")

# Residuals vs Genotype
plot(df$genotype, resid(m_anova),
     xlab = "Genotype",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Genotype")

```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(dplyr)

# # Ensure correct Week order
# df <- df %>%
#   mutate(
#     Week = factor(
#       Week,
#       levels = c("Preinduction", "1st week post induction", "2nd week post induction", "3rd week post induction")
#     )
#   )


# Plot: Dark preference by Week, colored by genotype, faceted by cohort
ggplot(df, aes(x = Week, y = dark_preference, color = genotype)) +
  geom_beeswarm(size = 2.5, cex = 1.1, priority = "density") +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Week),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.25,
    fatten = 1.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Week),
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.12,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Darkness preference (%)",
    color = "Genotype",
    title = "Dark preference across weeks by cohort"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )



```

  mutate(dark_preference = dark_preference - dark_preference[Week == "Preinduction"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Week %in% c("1st week", "2nd week"))
